scope: offline long-only Strict-R3 research on :00 control blocks; no live, canonical, exchange, admission, portfolio, or execution artifact modified
purpose: Implement reproducible strict-OOF two-stage residual and C0-C4 consensus ablation primitives for the attached base-recall pipeline.

contracts.layer1: Pre-2025 prequential scores are stitched to the immutable B0 control; post-2025 source-expansion rows are excluded unless present in B0.
contracts.delta1: C1-to-policy-residual isotonic maps are fit only from decision and resolved labels before the 28-day reserve; anchor quintile boundaries are training-only.
contracts.layer2: Six residual LambdaRank heads, binary residual-D2, and clipped Huber controls consume only cross-fitted Delta-1 anchors; all score references are training-fold references.
contracts.consensus: C0-C4 use fixed head groups and strictly-prior resolved reliability/support/OOD references.

validation.control_parity: 21 immutable :00 blocks; base score, rank42, anchor, C1, and upstream all maximum absolute delta 0.0

known_data_limitation: Historical score blocks persist aggregate C1 but not individual head outputs. The immutable models and exact C1 aggregate parity provide deterministic reconstruction evidence; a distinct stored-head-value comparison is unavailable.
